meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: Finds, reads, and reconstructs coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude, OpenCode, OMO/Senpi, and other local agent logs. Use when asked to find or search past sessions, transcripts, or subagent runs, or to recover what an earlier session did.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查找编码助手的历史会话,还原此前做过什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要找回之前 AI 编程会话干了什么,避免重复劳动。
copy.tagline_en: Find past coding-agent sessions and see what was done before
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use coding agents and need to recover what an earlier session did.

howto.what: 装上此技能后，当你问起过去的编程助手会话，Claude 会先在本机日志（Codex、Claude、OpenCode、Senpi 等）里搜索和读取原始记录，再据此还原那次会话的内容。它返回平台、会话 ID、文件路径、时间、模型、首尾用户消息、匹配原因等字段。
howto.when: 当你要求查找或搜索过去的编程助手会话、记录或子代理运行，或想还原之前某次会话做了什么（包括模糊记得「那次修 bug 的会话」）时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下上周关于 OpenCode 的会话
say.note: Claude 会先列出候选会话供你挑选。

say.text: 那次修复部署问题的会话是什么时候？
say.note: 会从模糊描述扩展多个关键词再搜索。

say.text: 搜索所有平台里提到 token usage 的会话
say.note: 会并行扫描各平台日志并返回匹配列表。

howto.what_en: When asked about past coding-agent sessions, Claude searches local logs (Codex, Claude, OpenCode, Senpi, etc.) first, then reads chosen transcripts. Output includes platform, id, path, timestamps, model, first/last user messages, and match reasons.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to find or search past sessions, transcripts, or subagent runs, to recover what an earlier session did, or when work may have been done before (e.g., "that bug-fix session").

say_en.text: Find my OpenCode sessions from last week.
say_en.note: Lists candidate sessions to pick from.

say_en.text: When did we fix the deploy issue?
say_en.note: Expands the vague memory into query lanes.

say_en.text: Search all platforms for sessions mentioning 'token usage'.
say_en.note: Scans platform logs in parallel and returns hits.
